F4.quote: Directionality of Semantic Labor (DSL) is a layered, computable measure of the direction in which a synthetic system's labor moves relative to the task a user commissioned.

F4.lineage: the framework: Directionality of Semantic Labor

F5.quote: A system can produce fluent, well-attributed output while having quietly abandoned the commissioned direction. Fluency is not fidelity; attribution is not direction.
F5.claim: what DSL measures that fluency and attribution miss
F5.lineage: the framework: Directionality of Semantic Labor
F5.date: undated (the page as fetched 2026-10-31; colophon surface_observed_at 2026-08-15)
